I've messaged all six sessions that are open right now, asking what to keep and what to drop. I haven't made any git changes yet.

What exists so far:
- **PR #13** (`steffen/final-prep`, draft): learnings and practice runs v8 to v10, including the clause trade (P02 scored 0.735).
- **PR #14** (`steffen/elicit`): an index-clause offer in round 1 and a full-e-mail writer mode.
- **`steffen/logs` branch**: practice logs and sessions.
- **Uncommitted change in `buyer/policy.py`**: a new anchor rule for founder-run job shops (spotted by a slow reply and a quote with no validity), and the agent no longer concedes in the next sheet after a large first price drop. I don't know yet which session made it.

When the sessions reply, I'll merge the agreed parts on a new branch off `main`, run `uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check .`, and open one PR that supersedes #13 and #14. I'll only close #13 and #14 if you confirm.
